fun_facts: Parker Washington was a four-star recruit and a first-team All-Houston Area selection as a senior at William B. Travis High School.
Parker Washington started all nine games as a true freshman at Penn State, catching 36 passes for 489 yards and six touchdowns. He also returned five kickoffs for 100 yards.
In 2021, Parker Washington caught 64 passes for 820 yards and four touchdowns.
In 2022, Parker Washington was an honorable mention All-Big Ten selection and caught 46 passes for 611 yards and two touchdowns.
Across three seasons at Penn State, Parker Washington made 146 catches for 1,920 yards and 12 touchdowns.

basis.reasoning: The Jaguars' draft announcement identifies Parker Washington as a wide receiver from Penn State University and says he played three seasons there.

excerpts:
Parker Washington, a wide receiver from Penn State University, on Saturday was selected by the Jaguars in Round 6 of the 2023 NFL Draft – the No. 185 overall selection.

Washington (5-feet-10, 204 pounds), who played three seasons for Penn State, caught 146 career passes for 1,920 yards and 12 touchdowns. He caught 46 passes for 611 yards and two touchdowns in 2022 after catching 64 passes for 820 yards and four touchdowns in 2021.

He caught a career-high six touchdown passes on 36 receptions with 489 yards in 2020. He was an honorable mention All-Big 10 selection in 2022.

Washington became the fourth Penn State player selected by the Jaguars in the NFL Draft. They selected Penn State tight end Brenton Strange Friday in Round 2 of the '23 draft.
citations.title: Jaguars Select Parker Washington with Pick 185 in 2023 NFL Draft
